query:
SELECT 
  attendeeId,
  sponsorId,
  COUNT(*) as meeting_count,
  GROUP_CONCAT(timeSlot ORDER BY timeSlot SEPARATOR ', ') as slots,
  GROUP_CONCAT(id ORDER BY timeSlot SEPARATOR ', ') as meeting_ids
FROM meetings
GROUP BY attendeeId, sponsorId
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY sponsorId, attendeeId;
